plain: The right to use land only until one dies

webster.text: An estate that continues during the life of the possessor.

example.quote: and having thus obtained life-estates in the government, they may fill up the vacancies themselves, by their controul over the mode of appointment;
example.cite: The Address and Reasons of Dissent of the Minority of the Convention of Pennsylvania to Their Constituents, Pennsylvania Packet and Daily Advertiser, Dec. 18, 1787
